title: Swift Gherkin test harness and project scaffolding
description:
Set up the Swift Package Manager project structure (swift/ directory), evaluate and integrate swift-gherkin-testing to execute .feature files from the shared features/ directory, implement the KanbusWorld test context (equivalent to Python's behave context and Rust's KanbusWorld), wire one trivial scenario end-to-end (cli_help.feature) to prove the pipeline works, and extend tools/check_spec_parity.py to track Swift step coverage as a third implementation.

Spec coverage target: features/cli/cli_help.feature (1 file, proof of concept).
